instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for layout to achieve the technical schematic dashboard look. Do NOT rely heavily on standard Shadcn Card unless heavily customized to look like forensic panels.
Implement the 'Forward to Check' feature as a functional interactive demo using React state. Fake a 2-3 second 'scanning' delay.
Include 'data-testid' on ALL CTAs, inputs, and the URL scanning form.
Backgrounds should be strictly dark (Obsidian Black). Avoid light mode entirely for this specific page.
Use Lucide icons, but styled with sharp lines and neon stroke colors.
Incorporate the provided `hero_grid_background` using a dark overlay `bg-black/85` so text remains completely readable.
